scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply forge --remote && wrangler deploy && pnpm run purge:sleep-hours:remote
scripts.purge:sleep-hours:remote: wrangler d1 execute forge --remote --command "UPDATE records SET data = json_remove(data, '$.sleepHours') WHERE type = 'checkin' AND json_valid(data) AND json_type(data, '$.sleepHours') IS NOT NULL"
